scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@ecommerce/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@ecommerce/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SHARED,API,WEB -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@ecommerce/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=@ecommerce/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@ecommerce/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@ecommerce/api && npm run build --workspace=@ecommerce/web
